description: Typed Python SDK for the Discogs API v2 (PyPI: discogs-sdk, import discogs_sdk), with sync and async clients, lazy loading, auto-paging iterators, bounded retries and optional response caching.
rules: This is jmfontaine/discogs-sdk: PyPI package discogs-sdk, imported as discogs_sdk (github.com/jmfontaine/discogs-sdk).
It is not python3-discogs-client (import discogs_client) and not crate-ai/discogs-sdk; never mix their APIs with this one.
Create one client per program: `with Discogs() as client:` or `async with AsyncDiscogs() as client:`; read the token from DISCOGS_TOKEN.
`.get()` returns a lazy proxy and sends no request; the first data attribute access fetches, so catch NotFoundError there.
With AsyncDiscogs, await a proxy to get its model and keep the proxy for sub-resources such as `artist_proxy.releases.list()`.

`search()` and paginated `.list()` methods fetch pages on demand, one logical GET per page; break early and never call list() on a large result set. `collection.folders.list()` and `fields.list()` return plain lists.
Use the Python field names (`catalog_number`, `extra_artists`); the raw payload is in `model.raw`.
A custom http_client must be an httpx2 client, never httpx; the SDK does not close it.
